ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Äriseadustik (Commercial Code), particularly §§ 135-178; Rahapesu ja terrorismi rahastamise tõkestamise seadus (Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Prevention Act), RT I, 16.11.2017, 4, as subsequently amended; Riigilõivuseadus (State Fees Act); e-Residentsuse seadus (e-Residency Act), as applicable; and Estonian Financial Intelligence Unit guidelines and circulars issued thereunder.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled copy of the beneficial owner's or authorized representative's passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public in the document holder's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and apostilled certificate of good standing / current extract from the foreign commercial register of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign commercial registry authority in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution or general meeting consent of the corporate shareholder authorizing formation of the Estonian Osaühing and appointment of the initial director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Management board or general meeting of the corporate shareholder, certified by notary or corporate secretary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address and bank reference for the ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public and recognized financial institution in the respective country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All designated shareholders, directors, beneficial owners, signatories, and high-level project partners must undergo mandatory screening against the EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions, Estonian national restrictive measures, and when USD settlement is used also OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list. Additionally, all relevant persons are checked against internationally accepted PEP databases and adverse-media/open-source intelligence. Positive PEP, sanctions, or politically significant findings trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, identification of the Estonian money laundering reporting officer, and, where required, a suspicious transaction report to the Estonian Financial Intelligence Unit under the MLTFPA.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Estonian e-Business Register / Commercial Register (Äriregister) - https://ariregister.rik.ee
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Business names must be entered in Latin script, may contain Estonian diacritical letters (ä, ö, ü, õ, š, ž), Arabic numerals, hyphens, and apostrophes in accordance with the Commercial Code. The name must be distinguishable from existing registered names, must not be misleading, and must include the legal form 'Osaühing' or the abbreviation 'OÜ'. Foreign-language names must be rendered in Latin-script transliteration; a name entered solely in Cyrillic or another non-Latin script is not accepted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for six months from the date of filing; it is not automatically renewable. A fresh name-reservation application may be submitted after the expiry of the initial period if the intended commercial register application has not yet been filed. If the Registrar rejects the proposed name, the applicant may lodge a written objection/challenge with the Registry Department of the Commercial Register within 30 days of receipt of the rejection. The Registrar must issue a written administrative decision; if the rejection is sustained, the applicant may appeal that decision to the competent county court in registry proceedings in accordance with the Estonian Code of Civil Procedure. Alternatively, the applicant may withdraw the rejected name and file a new, sufficiently distinct name application, or submit a written consent/waiver from the holder of a conflicting prior name or trademark.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual-office or legal-service address is permissible for an Estonian OÜ engaged in low-risk online retail of oversized furniture, provided that the address is a real, geographically identified postal address in Estonia, is not a P.O. Box only, and is capable of receiving legal process, court mail, bailiff notices, and official correspondence from the Business Register and Estonian Tax and Customs Board. This address need not be the physical location of business operations; a mail-forwarding and registered-office service provider is commonly used by e-Resident companies. Should the company later maintain physical inventory or a warehouse in Estonia, a separate VAT registration site and physical premises may be required to establish local commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a license-free online retail company: the estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Commercial Register or registrar officers is approximately 5%. If the company is VAT-registered in Estonia or claims an Estonian warehouse/customs-related substance, the probability of an unannounced Tax and Customs Board address/stock inspection increases to approximately 15-20%. Inconsistent public-register data or a mismatch between the registered office and declared business operations will materially raise inspection risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Estonian company-law, GDPR, tax classification, and cross-border e-commerce VAT readiness review

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Estonian Commercial Code (Äriseadustik), primarily Sections 135-145 on private limited companies and incorporation, Sections 180-181 on management board powers and representation, and Sections 182-183 on management board duties.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Tartu County Court Registration Department, maintaining the Estonian Business Register under the Centre of Registers and Information Systems.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for entry in the commercial register (kandeavaldus), together with the memorandum of association and articles of association; electronic incorporation is submitted through the Estonian e-Business Register portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The minimum share capital of an OÜ is EUR 0.01 per shareholder, subject to the statutory minimum of EUR 0.01 in total. Immediate payment may be deferred if permitted by the incorporation documents; no statutory escrow account is generally required. Contributions must be paid when due, and non-cash contributions require valuation and supporting documentation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accept and record the subscriptions for its shares as stated in the incorporation documents and confirm the corresponding capital contributions in accordance with the Commercial Code. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be established at the address recorded in the commercial register, with authority to update the address through the prescribed filing procedure. RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] be appointed as members of the management board, each authorized to represent the Company in accordance with the articles of association and registered representation rules. RESOLVED, that the management board is authorized to complete all registration, banking, tax, and operational formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm founders, business name, registered office, and activity code
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Estonian e-Business Register portal and Tartu County Court Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select an available company name ending in OÜ, confirm the Estonian registered office and contact person where applicable, identify shareholders and management board members, and select the principal EMTAK activity corresponding to online retail of furniture and home décor. Obtain written consent from the registered office provider if required.
required_dossiers: Management board member identification and consent
Registered office address and legal-use evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name or address is rejected, amend the application and resubmit. If the registry requests clarification, provide the requested evidence within the stated deadline and preserve the original filing reference.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Estonian e-Business Register portal; Estonian notary for non-electronic or notarized formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the memorandum of association, articles of association, share subscription terms, capital contribution terms, and management board consents. Sign electronically with an accepted Estonian ID, Mobile-ID, Smart-ID, or qualified electronic signature. Use a notary where an electronic route is unavailable or where a founder or representative requires notarized execution.
required_dossiers: Share subscription and capital contribution declarations
Management board consent and representation details
Power of attorney, if signed by a representative
Notarial certification and apostille or legalization, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct defective signatures, powers of attorney, translations, or notarizations and upload replacement documents. Foreign documents should be apostilled or legalized and translated into Estonian where requested.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the commercial register application and pay the state fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Estonian e-Business Register online incorporation service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic application for entry, attach or generate the incorporation documents, disclose beneficial owners, select the representation rules, and pay the applicable state fee electronically. For paper or notarial formation, the notary submits the application to the registry.
required_dossiers: Completed application for entry in the commercial register
Signed memorandum and articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the registry deficiency notice by the prescribed deadline. Correct the filing, pay any balance, and resubmit through the portal. A refusal may be challenged through the applicable court procedure or cured by filing a new compliant application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registry entry and activate post-incorporation records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Estonian Business Register, Tax and Customs Board, and commercial bank or payment institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the registry card and articles, verify the legal name, registry code, address, activity code, management board, and beneficial ownership data, and open the corporate bank or payment account. Establish accounting records, appoint an accounting provider if needed, and register for VAT only if the statutory threshold or voluntary registration conditions are met.
required_dossiers: Bank or payment account onboarding documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct registry data through the prescribed amendment filing. If a bank or payment institution rejects onboarding, provide enhanced source-of-funds, ownership, business-model, logistics, and customer-risk documentation or use another regulated institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Implement corporate governance and operational compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Management board; Estonian Tax and Customs Board; Estonian Consumer Protection and Technical Regulatory Authority where consumer matters apply
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the shareholder list, board decisions, accounting records, contracts, beneficial ownership data, and annual report calendar. Adopt website terms, distance-selling disclosures, privacy documentation, product-safety controls, warranty and returns procedures, and logistics controls for oversized furniture. Monitor VAT, payroll, employment, packaging, and consumer-law obligations.
required_dossiers: Shareholder and beneficial ownership register extracts
Product safety and supplier conformity files
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure compliance deficiencies through amended policies, supplemental filings, corrective customer notices, or voluntary tax and regulatory disclosures. Respond to authority inquiries within the stated statutory deadline.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ordinary online retail of oversized furniture and home décor without manufacturing, extraction, regulated storage, or other separately licensed activity. Relevant municipal building, fire, waste, and consumer authorities may apply to premises and operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general operating or manufacturing permit is required for the described online retail activity. A building-use notification, occupancy approval, or other premises-specific authorization may be required for a warehouse or showroom.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Estonian Environmental Board (Keskkonnaamet), applying the Environmental Impact Assessment and Environmental Management System Act
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from project-level EIA for ordinary e-commerce, retail, and non-industrial storage; screening may be required if a separate project falls within a listed development category.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No routine industrial wastewater, VOC, or process-emission permit is expected for ordinary retail. Discharges must comply with municipal sewer conditions and the Water Act. Packaging and operational waste must be separately managed under the Waste Act, with hazardous waste transferred only to authorized handlers. Any future manufacturing, coating, fuel storage, or significant emissions would require activity-specific permits and environmental assessment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No special industrial clearance is required for ordinary office-based e-commerce. A warehouse or showroom must satisfy building-use, fire-safety, evacuation, emergency-access, electrical, and structural-load requirements; fire equipment and inspections must comply with the Rescue Act and applicable technical standards. Employers must complete occupational risk assessment, workplace safety training, ergonomic controls, and employment health and safety documentation under Estonian occupational health and safety law.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Maksu- ja Tolliamet (Estonian Tax and Customs Board)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities register for Estonian TIN and VAT ID via e-Tax portal or local tax representative; submission of incorporation documents, beneficial ownership declarations, and AML/KYC requirements mandatory prior to issuance of statutory tax identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; Estonia applies territorial taxation under EU ATAD hybrid mismatch rules for cross-border structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing through e-ariregister system with digital stamps; API integration and immediate fiscal clearance reporting to Tax and Customs Board required for registered taxpayers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the EU or services supplied to non-EU customers; eligibility requires proof of export and non-EU delivery address.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Clawback of zero-rated VAT with penalties up to 100% of VAT amount plus interest; potential criminal prosecution for fraudulent export claims under Estonian tax legislation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Estonia is a euro-area member state with full capital and current account liberalisation under EU law (Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, arts. 63-65; Currency Act; Eesti Pank Act). No exchange controls restrict current account transactions, capital movements, or profit repatriation. Dividends from an OÜ to non-resident shareholders are freely transferable, subject to withholding tax under the Estonian Income Tax Act (20% regular rate, 14% for regularly distributed dividends in certain cases, 7% for specific cases, or 0% at the corporate level on undistributed profits). The euro is fully convertible; banks freely execute EUR and non-EUR wire transfers. Profit remittance hurdles are limited to compliance with AML/CFT due diligence by the correspondent bank, not to FX or Central Bank restrictions. For a home-furniture e-commerce exporter, proceeds from EU distance sales are treated as intra-Community supplies and are not subject to any surrender or conversion requirement. Non-EU online sales in USD/GBP may be settled in those currencies or converted to EUR without restriction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / FX Hedging Treasury Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High for use of EU/EEA-licensed e-money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise Business, Revolut Business, or Verifo as treasury complements, but with strict legal constraints: (i) the OÜ's Estonian banking and payment accounts must be held with a credit institution or an authorised EMI subject to PSD2/EBA regulatory equivalence; (ii) non-EU/EEA EMIs cannot serve as the primary treasury rail; they may only be used if they operate under an Estonian or EU passported electron-money licence and maintain segregated safeguarding accounts; (iii) outsourcing of core payment processing remains permissible, but the OÜ must exercise effective KYC and AML oversight under the Eesti Pank / Estonian FIU supervision; (iv) digital-only EMIs do not replace the requirement of a stable commercial banking relationship for escrowed consumer funds in the Estonian e-commerce market.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Estonian banks generally require one physical video interview for non-EU-resident directors or significant controllers. Directors holding a valid Estonian ID, digital ID, or e-Residency digital ID may complete KYC remotely through the bank's secure biometric video call system. For EU/EEA and UK residents with a confirmed business address in Estonia, remote onboarding is permitted without physical branch visit. If the director is resident in a high-risk jurisdiction (e.g., OECD/EU high-risk third-country list) or the company has complex trust/ownership chains, Estonian banks may require physical presence in Tallinn or an embassy signing block. Practical mandate: at least one authorised management board member (or a designated signatory holding an e-Residency card) must complete a face-to-face video interview in the bank's digital onboarding product; the Estonian business registry (e-Business Register) digital certificate is used to sign KYC forms; a physical visit to Estonia is strongly recommended but not statutorily mandatory for a straight-forward OÜ with a clean UBO chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO or director resident in a FATF-high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete org chart; notarised passport and address proof; declaration of funds origin; CV and business references; evidence that the director/UBO holds a valid Estonian e-Residency digital ID; audited financial statements of the OÜ or parent; detailed purpose of the Estonian accounts; closing AML questionnaire confirming no PEP relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High customer payment refund rates typical in oversized-furniture e-commerce
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed returns, refund and chargeback policy; shipment and insurance contracts; customer feedback resolution protocol; reserved chargeback funds; payment processor agreements (Stripe and Affirm) showing confirmation of refund handling capability; treasury policy limiting refund liability by holding a designated refund reserve in the operational account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large volume of cross-border e-commerce settlement credits from BNPL and card acquirers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Acquiring/PSP contract showing settlement cadence and finality; export and order documentation for the underlying furniture sales; VAT/EU distance selling registration; a treasury flow matrix reconciling customer payment by Stripe/Affirm to the bank IBAN; audited monthly sales reports and Freedom of Payment Explanation letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual financing of the OÜ via shareholder loan or intercompany booking to avoid dividend tax
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Loan agreement with market-rate interest; board resolution approving the loan; repayment schedule; funds-path demonstration from lender to OÜ; CBC/tax transparency statements confirming arm's length and no hidden dividend distribution under the Estonian Income Tax Act §50-53.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No physical warehouse or commercial address in Estonia
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: If the company is an e-commerce intermediary without storage, present: registered business address in Estonia; contract with a licensed Estonian logistics partner or fulfilment centre in a EU country; comprehensive liability insurance; local director with actual management authority; and evidence that the Estonian address is not a mere virtual shell (meeting room, phone line, mailbox used regularly).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocols: inbound equity or shareholder loan must be received via SWIFT MT103 (SEPA SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR-denominated flows) to the OÜ's designated IBAN account. The injection is documented in the e-Business Register within 30 days of board approval. Purpose codes should use the ISO 20022 universal purpose 'COLC' (capital contribution to a resident company by non-resident shareholder) or 'SLOA' (intercompany shareholder loan) as per Eesti Pank Codes; for simpler bank forms, 'Equity Injection' or 'Shareholder Loan' must be clearly indicated. Verification: banks require the OÜ's board resolution, the shareholder's UBO KYC documentation, the source-of-wealth statement, and, where the capital injection exceeds EUR 30,000, an Estonian accounting certificate or tax declaration of contributed capital. No mandatory Central Bank approval applies.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlement clearing rails: SWIFT MT103 SEPA Credit Transfer for routine EUR disbursements to EU freight forwarders and suppliers; MT103/MT202 COV for USD/GBP and non-EU beneficiary payments; commercial letter of credit (MT700) or documentary collection for high-value or strategic large-volume supplier contracts. For oversized-furniture cross-border procurement, the OÜ should use bank-issued instruction with invoice matching; the payment must quote the purchase order, invoice number, and Harmonized System (HS) code; customs declarations align with the Estonian Tax and Customs Board's import one-stop-shop mechanism; export disbursements from Estonia are unrestricted. A CHF/SEK/PLN or USD contingency sub-account may be opened to support forward settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/NOK, EUR/SEK, EUR/CNH up to available CB licensing)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in permitted emerging-market currencies for covering supplier costs where onshore forwards are unavailable
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD and EUR/CNH) matching the duration of the oversized-furniture import/sale cycle
FX options (calls/puts) and zero-cost collars through licensed EU investment firms or banks under ISDA/EEA Master Agreement
Estonian bank-account multi-currency balances with automatic conversion at spot/forward rate, considered synthetic FX hedge

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (majandusaasta aruanne) - management report, annual accounts, and distribution proposal filed with the commercial register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Estonian Business Registry (Äriregister) via e-äriregister portal; administered by the Centre of Registers and Information Systems (RIK)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the financial year-end; calendar-year entities must file by 30 June of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry enforcement warning issued after 10 months; EUR 200 state enforcement fine (sunniraha) if the report is still missing; court fine up to EUR 300 for late filing; repeated default results in forced deletion from the commercial register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership (kasusaaja) registry return - annual re-confirmation of UBO data, 25%+ shareholding, and control details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Estonian Business Registry (Äriregister) - Beneficial Owner information module; AML supervision by the FIU (Rahapesu Andmebüroo)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial filing with the first annual report; subsequent shareholding or control changes reported within 30 days; data re-verified at each annual report filing due by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry enforcement order with EUR 200 sunniraha for non-filing; court fine for continuing default; penalty orders under the Anti-Money Laundering Act for knowingly false declarations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return on distributed profits (Form TSD) - settlement of 20%/14% dividend tax when the annual report's distribution proposal is executed
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Estonian Tax and Customs Board (Maksu- ja Tolliamet)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 10th day of the month following the dividend payment or other taxable distribution; no filing obligation in a zero-distribution year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Arrears interest of 0.06% per day; tax assessment and penalty interest for under-declared distributions; misdemeanor fines for non-declaration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A full statutory audit by a certified auditor is required if the OÜ exceeds at least two of the following at the balance-sheet date: annual revenue EUR 4,000,000; total assets EUR 2,000,000; average employees 50. A statutory review (limited assurance) is required if at least two of the following are exceeded: revenue EUR 1,200,000; total assets EUR 600,000; employees 6. Public-interest entities and consolidated groups are always audited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Estonian GAAP (Hea raamatupidamistava) under the Accounting Act; IFRS-EU is applied by listed groups and entities exercising the option; micro-enterprises may apply simplified micro-company reporting rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO data must be complete and accurate before filing the annual report; any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial control (25% or more) must be reported to the e-Business Registry within 30 days; the management board confirms the UBO schedule in the annual report; at least one annual review must be performed at the general meeting when accounts are approved.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (osanike nimekiri) - kept by the registry or management board
Register of Directors / Management Board minutes (juhatuse protokollid)
Minute Book of shareholders' meetings (üldkoosoleku protokollid)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $220-$650 per year for a standard registered-office address and mail handling; full corporate secretarial service $430-$970 per year
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $3,240-$8,640 for a statutory audit of a mid-size OÜ; $1,080-$2,700 for a statutory review engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on retained/undistributed profits; 20% of gross distribution (formula 20/80 of the net amount) on ordinary profit distributions; reduced 14% of gross (formula 14/86) on 'regular' distributions within the three-year average of previous taxable distributions
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Deferred taxation until distribution: profits are tax-exempt while retained; the 14/86 regular-distribution rate rewards steady dividend policies; no annual CIT base/provision is required; the e-commerce activities do not alter the regime. VAT (22%) and payroll taxes (income tax 20%, social tax 33%, UI 0.8%) apply separately as cash-flow/turnover taxes.
